in_marathi.name: Manikram
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manikram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manikram is derived from Sanskrit words 'Mani' meaning jewel and 'Krama' meaning power. It is the name of a king in Hindu mythology who is known for his wealth and power. The name is often given to children born on a Tuesday and is considered lucky for those in creative fields.
